summary: Surface blit helper for a pair of surface descriptors. Each of a2/a3 selects a surface by flags at +6 words: flags 0x4/0x8 resolve an object through its vtable method at offset 60 (backed by +4/+5), while flags 0x1/0x2 use a direct pointer at +2/+3. After resolving both surfaces, calls SurfaceBlitOperation and stores its result in *this, returning -1 on any non-zero error. When the descriptor flags include 0xC the resolved surface is released through its vtable release method at offset 8. Returns 0 on success. Called by sub_5429B0 (005429B0).

operations.description: Resolve the source surface from a2: when flags a2[6] & 0x4 and a2[4] is non-null, or a2[6] & 0x8 and a2[5] is non-null, invoke the vtable method at offset 60 on the resolved object to produce a4, store the result in *this, and return -1 when it is non-zero.
Else when a2[6] & 0x1 and a2[2] is non-null, use a4 = a2[2] directly as the source surface pointer.
Else when a2[6] & 0x2 and a2[3] is non-null, use a4 = a2[3]; otherwise return -1.

Resolve the destination surface from a3 identically: vtable method at offset 60 when flags a3[6] & 0x4/0x8 back a3[4]/a3[5] (result stored in *this, -1 on error), else a3[2], else a3[3]; no valid pointer returns -1, otherwise v15 holds the resolved destination.
SurfaceBlitOperation(v15, 0, 0, a4, 0, 0, 1, 0) blits the source surface onto the destination; store its result in *this and return -1 when non-zero.
When a2[6] & 0xC, release the resolved source a4 through its vtable release method at offset 8.
When a3[6] & 0xC, release the resolved destination v15 through its vtable release method at offset 8.
Return 0 on successful blit after any required releases.
Invoked by sub_5429B0 (005429B0) to perform the paired surface blit.
